title: Close to Broadway w Rooftop Deck/Brand New!
description:
Experience luxury and comfort in this new, spacious home. With stunning vaulted ceilings, beautiful finishes, and abundant natural light, you'll feel the love poured into the design. Offering 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, it's an ideal spot for groups to spread out. Centrally located, just 1 mile from 12 South, 2 miles from The Gulch, and Downtown.

The space
We are proud to say this property is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after each stay according to the protocols set forth by the CDC. 

This spot was both thoughtfully and functionally designed.

 ✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Free Parking

BEDROOMS:

First floor:
1 queen bed downstairs 
1 full bathroom 

2nd floor:
1 queen bed 
1 full bathroom connected to the bedroom

1  Master bedroom king 
1 Master bath double vanity Stand up shower 

3rd level 
Queen bed 
Full bathroom double doors one for the bedroom other for the living room space

KITCHEN: 
The house includes a fully equipped kitchen for travelers looking to stay in and cook up a feast!

LIVING ROOM: 
With a large sofa and several accent chairs, we welcome our guests to sit back, relax, and enjoy some streaming. The couch in the living room does convert to a sofa bed if need be.

BATHROOMS: 
There are 4 bathrooms, providing just the right amount of privacy for every traveler. 

BONUS ROOM: 
Hang out and enjoy a cup of coffee while overlooking the French doors to the balcony. The couch in this room is AWESOME for snuggling up and watching your favorite shows! This couch also converts to a sofa bed.

DECK: 
Enjoy dinner under the sky or just hang out on the spacious deck! 

PARKING: 
2 car garage and if you have more than 2 cars, please inquire about additional parking. 

LOCAL GUESTS MUST REQUEST BEFORE BOOKING.
